strings.en: I see... So the Nadesico has gone...
Yes. It seems to have headed for Mars, just as we expected.
And three Gundams appeared chasing an unknown enemy... Curious.
They said they're acting on Major Ulube's orders. But...
Neo Japan... Major Ulube Ishikawa, you say?
Indeed, I've heard nothing of that.
Yes. They descended to Earth chasing that mysterious enemy,
so we couldn't get any details, but...
Oh, and I mentioned earlier that we launched the HLV,
but the Zambot team also went into space chasing the Gaizok battleship.
Please join up with them as well.
I don't mind, but will your forces on the surface be all right?
We've had some unexpected reinforcements, so don't worry.
Could you mean that crane we heard about?
Yes. I plan to hear the details from them later,
but it seems they're not enemies.
In that case, the suspicions about Hazard at the base only grow deeper.
Space pirates, the Bunker, up there, the Hyakki Empire down here...
We already have more than enough trouble as it is...
For now, all we can do is fight defensively.
The Bunker and the Gyandlar seem to be harassing Zeon too,
so they're stuck on the defensive as well. That's some consolation.
I'll contact you later with more on the Elshank.
(Now then... First, let's hear what they have to say...)
What's the big idea, telling us to wait in the study room!?
We told you, we came from Mars to warn you about a crisis!
Don't make me say it again. The Gandor Team is a military unit, okay?
We can't just take your word for it.
It's not like we're locking you in a cell, okay?
Just get me whoever's in charge! That Commander whatshisname!
What happened to contacting Ronin like you said you would!?
Joe! That's enough already.
What good is making our position worse!?
She's right, Big Bro. This is bad.
What are you trying to pull?
Hm... What's going on? It's pretty noisy. Something wrong?
Oh, Nagare. I wanted them to wait in the study room
while Commander Hazuki reports in to Captain Bright, but...
They're making a fuss, huh.
Hold on a sec! Joe's the only one complaining!
Yeah, yeah. If you tell us to wait, we'll wait.
Hey, you two! So I'm the only bad guy here!?
Looks that way.
Come on, now, just behave yourself until the Commander's back.
We don't want to get rough.
Oh, that's...
...Sure enough... The design concept is nothing like a mobile suit's...
It's neither Federation nor Zeon...
Looks closer to Getter Robo or Dancougar.
Bernie! Where have you been?
Things are complicated enough, so don't go wandering off.
Well, I went to the deck to take a look at their robots.
Bakuryu... is that what it's called? That dragon-like robot.
It looks so cool.
Sorry. I'm the one who invited him.
Honestly, Lieutenant Amada...
I wanted to see that ninja-like robot that flew off afterward too...
Did you say ninja!?
H-Hey, you there, did you just say ninja...?
Huh? Yeah, what about it?
What's all this racket?
What're you staring at? We ain't a sideshow.
...Know your place. There's no proof you aren't enemy agents.
What'd you say!? Why, you...
Stop it, Joe!
You too, Tetsuya. Why do you pick fights with everyone?
Hmph. Them, and that ninja-like robot showing up out of nowhere...
there's too much here that's suspicious.
You bastard, I've had about enough...
Wait, hey! Did you say ninja!?
Ninja!?
What's wrong? You've gone pale.
We came to Earth looking for that ninja...!
Princess, you should rest a while longer...
That's right, Princess. Whatever you do, your body comes first, y'know?
I know...
But to the people here, we are unwelcome guests...
We have a mission to find the ninja.
I cannot drag others into it...
Princess... Judging from the battle earlier,
there seem to be many brave people here, a match for the Za Boom Army.
Why not ask them for help...?
I was just thinking the same thing.
What do you say, Princess Romina? To fill the hole that traitor Ilbora left...
How dare you! It's because of you lot that Lord Ilbora left the ship!
Do you understand that!?
You mustn't raise your voice in front of the Princess.
...Sorry, Princess. That was out of line.
Hey, how're you feeling?
Oh, looks like she's awake.
Are you from this ship...? Thank you so very much for everything.
I don't know how I can ever thank you... Um...
Oh, uh, the name's Koji Kabuto. Just call me Koji, Princess.
Yes. Sir Koji, may I ask you something...?
"Sir Koji"...? Heh, that kinda tickles. Ask me anything.
Koji! You're practically drooling...!
Why did you take in people from another world like us...?
Huh? Why, you ask...
At first, we crash-landed on Mars.
We met Joe and the others there... but the Mars forces hounded us.
Hmm, how do I put it... There's someone I know who's like that.
An alien?
Yeah. He lost his home planet... and now he fights for Earth.
So that the same tragedy never happens again.
...You guys kinda give off the same vibe as him...
I feel like you're alike, y'know?
...We too... came all this way to save our home star system...
I figured it was something like that. The Commander here isn't that
pigheaded... I think. So rest a while longer.
...Yes. Thank you for your kindness...
I'm coming in. Okay?
You're...
Shiro. Shiro Amada. I'm here as a guard, technically.
...Truth is, I'd rather not be.
Sir Shiro, we...
You've got your reasons, right? Just wait a little longer.
Commander Hazuki should have something to tell you.
Why did the people here take us in,
not knowing if we were friend or foe?
You fought the invaders alongside us, didn't you?
We help each other out, right?
But it's true that we dragged you, who had nothing to do with it,
into our fight...
Friend or foe... I don't think that matters much.
At least... not to me.
If we understand each other, maybe we can get along with the invaders.
You're soft, pal. Are you really the guy who was fighting earlier?
...I hear that a lot.
It's Fa Yuiry. I'm coming in.
Please, come in.
...Is this a good time? Um, Romina? The Commander is asking for you.
Would you mind coming to the bridge?
Yes. Come, Princess...
Yes, let's go.
...I hope Joe hasn't jumped the gun and started a ruckus...
O great Barao. The cherished dream of the Great Demon Empire...
To revive the Demon Century, that thing is needed...
Is that what you say?
Without fail. The surface seems in an uproar... but they're no match for us.
First, we shall expose that so-called laboratory
and bring back even a fragment of a clue. ...Send out Gante!
...Can you stand letting the likes of him steal the glory, Brother...?
It doesn't matter... He may be the Prince, but in the end, he's just...
...So Hazard, commander of the Mars Frontier Base, really is...
Yeah, like I told you before,
that guy's in cahoots with the Za Boom Army, the aliens on Mars.
The Mars Frontier Base, huh? Isn't that...
the cyborgs that revolted while we were fighting the Dinosaur Empire?
The Meganoids.
Cyborgs built by the authority on bio-high-tech,
Dr. Sozo Haran...
The final battle was on Mars, so the surface wasn't badly damaged...
And I heard it was his kid who finished them off.
Banjo Haran...
Afterward, he blew up the machine he'd used with his own hands...
The Mars Frontier Base I grew up in was a converted Meganoid base.
Its commander is a guy named Hazard Pasha.
And like we said, the Elshank... that battleship...
came down to Mars, and that's how we ended up here.
We want you to lend us a hand.
Now then, what to do...
Um... If we're a bother, we will leave at once...
Thank you truly for everything. Come, Shaff...
H-Hold on, Princess Romina! Hey, doesn't this mean anything to you!?
She was driven from her planet and came here betting on a ninja legend!
Don't you wanna help her out!?
I get what you're saying. But...
The truth is, the Earth Sphere has its hands full too.
Right. We can't just barge in and demand help, can we? ...Let's go, Joe.
Hang on, Lenny. Hey, Commander, did you get in touch with Ronin?
Joe! Is that any way to ask someone for a favor!?
Shut it, Lenny! ...Come on, please.
I know Ronin would help us out.
I know. Either way, I need to report this to the Admiral.
...Looks like we lost them completely, Domon.
Dammit! Where the hell did it go!?
Don't be so impatient, Domon. Rushing won't get you good results.
Right, Master Asia?
There are other enemies besides the Death Army. It won't be that easy.
I know that! But even so, I...!!
Domon. That is precisely why you are a fool...!
Huh? ...Master!?
Do you think you can defeat him with your current strength!?
If you fought him now, you would only be cut down... Can you not see that!?
Ngh... B-But!
Domon, you have grown strong... but as you are, you are no match for him.
Your power is greater than this. Train harder and grow stronger...!
...Master.
A ninja legend, you say...
Ninja in this day and age may sound absurd,
but they're serious... Please, help Joe and the others.
...Guests from planet Radorio, sixty thousand light-years away...
Do you think I'd treat them poorly, Ronin?
Admiral!? Then...!?
Hmm, why not? If there are ninja, I'd like to see one too!
(Th-That was easy...)
They say they'll help us, Princess Romina.
Thank you, everyone.
Having Princess Romina's group should help you out too, eh, Hazuki?
Well, can't be helped. I'll lend you a hand.
Listen to you. Isn't Tobikage's power more reliable than yours?
True, that robot's strength was something else.
Then, Princess Romina, you and the people of the Elshank
will be following my orders... Is that acceptable?
Yes. We're in your care, everyone.
You did it, Joe.
Yeah, thanks.
Good thing we asked Ronin.
By the way, Hazuki, Yurika and the others on their way to Mars...
do they know about this?
Yes. Word has gone out to them through Captain Bright.
Good, then there's nothing to worry about.
Princess, now we can search for the ninja.
Everyone, I am truly grateful.
You don't have to keep bowing like that, Princess Romina.
Changing the subject, what was that robot Lieutenant Amada mentioned?
Where is Dunbine!?
I'll take you down in one blow!
Dunbine?
That should've hit!
What's going on?
You're mine! Dunbine!!
Kyaaah!
Garalia's different today... I sense more power than from Burn!
What!?
Garalia!
If it's brute force you want...!
I won't lose!!
What's that light?
Damn iiit!
Ugh... ngh...
Hyaaaah!
Ngh, again!?
Commander! An unknown large mobile weapon has appeared in Shinjuku too!
Shinjuku, Tokyo, the Mutron Lab... and the mountains of Mie, was it?
Yes. We received word from Captain Bright.
The mobile weapon in Shinjuku... is the space pirates', the Bunker's.
Mie? Where's that?
Mie Prefecture... There's no major city or base there, is there?
...Iga Village...? Right, the Za Boom bunch are looking for
a ninja too, you said, Princess.
Yes. Is there some connection...!?
That's the home of the Iga ninja, ain't it?
...That's it! That's the place, Princess Romina.
Those Za Boom bastards got the info too!
Then let's not waste a second!
But ninja these days are...
Hold on, Lieutenant... Let's just go and see.
Sooner or later, the answer's gonna come out anyway.
Either way, we've got to drive off the invaders.
Ridiculous. Why won't anyone tell them the truth?
Tsurugi, they'll find out either way.
...Knowing just enough makes it harder.
Gandor, launch! All hands to your stations!
Princess Romina, please have the Elshank follow the Gandor.
Thank you, Commander Hazuki...
(What's happening in the Earth Sphere...? Excellen... how are you...?)
